contract: admin/design-contract.md: staff queue, actual server payment and statuses, existing Master Coffee palette/fonts; native labels/focus; desktop and narrow layouts.

accessibility.evidence: Inspected rendered labels, native buttons/forms and visible hierarchy. Real browser test verifies Tab moves from email to password; primary actions are at least44px. Main light button contrast5.81:1 and dark primary button contrast4.75:1 against white were checked by WCAG luminance formula. No unhandled browser errors. Screen reader and physical camera remain untested.

responsive.evidence: Inspected queue and menu screenshots at1440x900 and390x844. Browser asserts no horizontal document overflow at both sizes and with root font20px; narrow menus scroll inside bounded list, editor fields wrap without overlap.

loading.evidence: Delayed a real queue request600ms; refresh disabled and orders-list aria-busy=true observed; loading screenshot saved before completion.

empty.evidence: Actual development database had no active staff orders before test created its order; empty queue message observed and captured.

error.evidence: Reused consumed server QR after completion; backend409 surfaced as QR has already been used, with no local success. Unauthorized customer role shows cabinet access error.

partial.evidence: Aborted one real queue request; UI retained previous order detail and explicitly marked last data stale. Removed failure and manual refresh recovered.

success.evidence: Real local API order MC-001004: QR lookup, payment confirmation, accepted/preparing/ready/completed; backend GET verifies completed. Menu save preserves eligibility; hidden story image upload/create/delete all confirmed by API.

permission.evidence: Staff cannot see admin navigation; customer cabinet login denied; revoking staff session on server then refreshing clears account details and prompts sign-in.

renderedEvidence.observation: Staff queue and actual server sum, line options, separate payment/status badges and payment action.
Queue and detail stack, payment/cancel buttons fit width, comment and server totals wrap correctly.
Catalogue editor including preserved loyalty checkbox and sizes; no stretched empty editor.
Bounded catalogue list and full-width editor with wrapped checkbox labels and numeric size row.
Real request pending with loading feedback.
Actual empty active queue before order creation.
Last known order remains visible alongside failed-refresh message.
Server-completed order with issuance confirmation and no further lifecycle controls.
Customer role denied cabinet entry after old staff account DOM was cleared.

limitations: Headless isolated Chrome against local development API; no physical phone or camera hardware test.
Docker/nginx serving could not be exercised in this local run; native Node fallback was used.
